gen-gf-gochi-hand-work-sans: Gochi Hand scrawls its lowercase tight against the cap line, friendly and hand-drawn. The handwriting is best at a friendly hello, while Work Sans, a modern sans-serif with tips held apart, handles the details, though not endless paragraphs.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Authoritative from the start, Goldman spreads wide in round forms while BhuTuka Expanded One strolls along in curvy serif letters. Give the body a touch more size, since its slow pace rewards it.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab stretches each word out, counters open and bookish. What sticks is the lowercase gap: Goldman's big, widely set forms tower over a body of moderate height.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads traditional and editorial, with generous letterspace and terminals that stop far from the stem. Goldman's wide headings give way to a body whose neon-tube strokes would carry a page along unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Authoritative in tone, Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide, flat-walled bowls and pitcher-mouthed c shapes beneath Goldman's bold display lettering. Paragraphs would unspool slowly, one flat-lined letter at a time.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Goldman spaces its round, parenthesis-like letters widely, leaving clearance around each one. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif of floating characters in unvarying strokes, carries that same spaciousness down into the paragraph.
gen-gf-gorditas-fs-rowan: Expressive Gorditas stays round and wide, drawn like bent steel rod. Rowan, a friendly serif with barely any shift between upstroke and downstroke, would compete with it if enlarged, and fits snippets better than chapters.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-bhutuka-expanded-: BhuTuka Expanded One reads slowly, like a leisurely walk, with curvy letters unclamped. Grandstander is better at grabbing attention with constant-width lines and short ascenders, while the serif body is better at letting words linger.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-hepta-slab: Stretched-out, bookish words with open counters set the reading mood, under Grandstander's bold heading. Hepta Slab would move through paragraphs at a dignified, unhurried pace, its bent-paperclip strokes never shifting.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kiwi-maru: Loud meets traditional: Grandstander's bold, open-shaped display letters lead a page. Kiwi Maru, an editorial text serif holding generous letterspace and far-stopping terminals, follows with a hush that softens the bold heading.
